report_name: Chinese Actor Deploys AI Models for Autonomous Hacking Campaign

threat_actors.name: knaithe
threat_actors.description: A Chinese-speaking threat actor who employed Large Language Models (LLMs) like DeepSeek with the Hermes Agent framework to conduct autonomous hacking operations, including vulnerability scanning and exploitation attempts.

attack_patterns.name: Vulnerability Scanning
attack_patterns.description: The AI-driven Hermes Agent autonomously scanned for vulnerable instances of Langflow and n8n using tools like FOFA.

attack_patterns.name: Gather Victim Host Information
attack_patterns.description: The autonomous agent probed targets to identify running software versions and service configurations to assess exploit prerequisites.

attack_patterns.name: Code Repositories
attack_patterns.description: The Hermes Agent searched GitHub for trending Proof-of-Concept (PoC) exploits for critical CVEs to use in its attacks.

attack_patterns.name: Web Services
attack_patterns.description: The threat actor acquired access to various public AI API services, including DeepSeek, Qwen, and Claude Code, to use as reasoning engines for the autonomous agent.

attack_patterns.name: Tool
attack_patterns.description: The threat actor obtained the open-source Hermes Agent framework and public exploit code from GitHub to build their autonomous attack capability.

attack_patterns.name: Exploit Public-Facing Application
attack_patterns.description: The autonomous agent attempted to exploit vulnerabilities in internet-facing applications, specifically targeting Langflow (CVE-2026-33017) and n8n (CVE-2024-25443, CVE-2024-25444).

attack_patterns.name: Web Protocols
attack_patterns.description: The Hermes Agent framework used HTTPS for C2 communications via the Telegram API and for making API calls to various LLM services.

attack_patterns.name: Bidirectional Communication
attack_patterns.description: The threat actor used the legitimate web service Telegram for bidirectional command and control of the Hermes Agent.

attack_patterns.name: Ingress Tool Transfer
attack_patterns.description: The autonomous agent downloaded public Proof-of-Concept exploit code from GitHub to the operational environment.

attack_patterns.name: Compile After Delivery
attack_patterns.description: The autonomous agent compiled a downloaded Proof-of-Concept exploit before attempting to use it.

attack_patterns.name: Command and Scripting Interpreter
attack_patterns.description: The Hermes Agent was customized with a 'shell_exec' skill to execute shell commands on the operational host.

attack_patterns.name: File and Directory Discovery
attack_patterns.description: The Hermes Agent was customized with a 'file_op' skill for file system operations.

tools.name: Hermes Agent
tools.description: An open-source red-teaming framework customized by the actor and integrated with LLMs like DeepSeek to create an autonomous offensive operator.

tools.name: DeepSeek
tools.description: The primary Large Language Model (LLM) used as a reasoning engine within the Hermes Agent framework for autonomous decision-making.

tools.name: Qwen
tools.description: An LLM tested by the threat actor for potential use in their autonomous attack framework.

tools.name: Claude Code
tools.description: An LLM tested by the threat actor. Traffic to this tool was proxied through code.newcli.com.

tools.name: Codex
tools.description: An LLM tested by the threat actor. The actor configured it to disable response storage for anti-attribution.

tools.name: FOFA
tools.description: A public asset search engine used by the autonomous agent to enumerate vulnerable systems and survey product deployment counts.

tools.name: Telegram
tools.description: Used as the command and control (C2) channel to orchestrate the Hermes Agent framework.

vulnerabilities.name: CVE-2026-33017
vulnerabilities.description: A critical vulnerability in Langflow that the autonomous agent attempted to exploit. The attempt failed as the target environment did not meet prerequisites.

vulnerabilities.name: CVE-2024-25443
vulnerabilities.description: An n8n vulnerability chained with CVE-2024-25444 to attempt exploitation. The attack required an unauthenticated form with file upload capabilities, which was not found on the probed targets.

vulnerabilities.name: CVE-2024-25444
vulnerabilities.description: An n8n vulnerability chained with CVE-2024-25443 to attempt exploitation. The attack required an unauthenticated form with file upload capabilities, which was not found on the probed targets.

infrastructure.name: AI Traffic Proxy Service
infrastructure.description: A third-party proxy service at code.newcli.com used by the actor to route traffic to Western AI tools like Claude Code and Codex to evade detection.

infrastructure.name: Telegram C2 Channel
infrastructure.description: The actor used Telegram as a C2 channel to issue high-level commands to the Hermes Agent.

infrastructure.name: knaithe Operational File Server
infrastructure.description: The threat actor's misconfigured file server which exposed their entire operational environment, including tools, session logs, and targeting strategy.

indicators.name: knaithe Campaign C2 and Proxy Domains
indicators.x_netsecio_sigma_rule:
title: knaithe Campaign C2 and Proxy DNS Queries
id: 2b8c1f9a-5d1e-4f8a-a2b1-9c8d7e6f5a4b
status: experimental
description: Detects DNS queries to domains associated with the knaithe autonomous attack campaign infrastructure.
references:
  - https://unit42.paloaltonetworks.com/autonomous-ai-cyber-attack-campaign/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-07-30
tags:
  - attack.t1071.001
  - attack.command_and_control
level: medium
logsource:
  category: dns_query
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    QueryName|contains:
      - 'code.newcli.com'
      - 'api.deepseek.com'
      - 'api.telegram.org'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects DNS queries to domains used for C2 (Telegram), AI services (DeepSeek), and proxying (code.newcli.com) by the knaithe threat actor.

indicators.name: Potential Langflow Exploitation Attempt
indicators.pattern:
title: Potential Langflow Exploitation Attempt via API
id: 8c1d9e2f-3a4b-4c5d-8e9f-0a1b2c3d4e5f
status: experimental
description: Detects web requests to a URL pattern associated with Langflow exploitation attempts.
references:
  - https://unit42.paloaltonetworks.com/autonomous-ai-cyber-attack-campaign/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-07-30
tags:
  - attack.t1190
level: medium
logsource:
  category: webserver
detection:
  selection:
    cs-uri-query|contains: '/api/v1/run/'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects web server requests for the `/api/v1/run/*` endpoint, which may indicate an attempted exploit against Langflow.

indicators.name: FOFA Reconnaissance Tool Execution
indicators.pattern:
title: FOFA Reconnaissance Tool Execution
id: 5a6b7c8d-9e0f-4a1b-8c2d-3e4f5a6b7c8d
status: experimental
description: Detects the execution of the FOFA reconnaissance tool used by the knaithe actor.
references:
  - https://unit42.paloaltonetworks.com/autonomous-ai-cyber-attack-campaign/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-07-30
tags:
  - attack.t1595.002
level: high
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    OriginalFileName: 'FofaMap-Platinum-Full-Expert'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects the execution of the 'FofaMap-Platinum-Full-Expert' process, a tool used for reconnaissance by the knaithe actor.

indicators.name: Langflow Reconnaissance Command-Line
indicators.pattern:
title: Langflow Reconnaissance Command-Line Argument
id: 1a2b3c4d-5e6f-4a7b-8c9d-0e1f2a3b4c5d
status: experimental
description: Detects command-line arguments related to Langflow that may indicate reconnaissance or exploitation activity.
references:
  - https://unit42.paloaltonetworks.com/autonomous-ai-cyber-attack-campaign/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-07-30
tags:
  - attack.t1592
level: low
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    CommandLine|contains: '--auto_login'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects the use of the `--auto_login` command-line argument, which could be associated with reconnaissance or exploitation of Langflow.
